about_the_game:
Kenix and the Cat King is an Open World RPG based in the funny world of the Cat King!

Jump paws first into a grand adventure where the dogs in this town are up to something secretly! This is worrying for any cat!  Stop the Dog King's evil plan to change your home into the world's first town run by DOGS!!! Explore the various city areas!  Enjoy the Cat King's funny ideas and how he sees the world! Explore and meet strange new creatures, cats with unique personalities and abilities while growing your own power to defeat well trained dogs! Help cat lovers in various side quests and gaining rewards to help you on your way!

 

Battle Mode Combat!

Battle in this game (and there is a lot of them) takes place in Battle Mode when you meet up with an enemy or decide to challenge one. Remember to choose your team wisely as their different abilities can change your fate leaving you chewing old bones or going home victorious to delicious chicken pieces! Some even have magic, can use special equipment or have magic! Know your cats and cat lovers well!

 

Unique Cats! Unique Stories! Unique Abilities!

Each cat has specific skills and abilities but some will need or be enhanced by choosing what to buy or find greatly. There are even side quests which sometimes reveal secret special items or help your cat enhance their abilities or even find new allies. Understand what your cat can and cannot do well so you always have the advantage over ANY dog!

 

City Exploration!

The city has many areas with various cats, creatures that live there and characters to interact with. Discover the local Japanese idol EREN CHAN who entertains everyone with her music! Find strange sweet sellers and kids annoyed with their parents in the SHOPPING MALL! Visit the THREE CATS HOTEL a special place for cat lovers and your friends! Even talk to your close friend Azumi the Cat Witch! Exploring and finding secrets and gaining fun magical items such as ERENCELLENT cola is the ball of yarn for cats looking to test their wits in various ways!

 

Soundtrack

Experience the uniquely cute and funny songs from Japanese underground idol EREN CHAN!!

Learn magic from Azumi the Cat Witch! Meet strange and funny characters! Battle dog troops and even stranger enemies!
